test: AWS Lambda deployment validation with synthetic traffic
scope: Synthetic traffic sent by the author through the Lambda Invoke API using Function URL (payload v2.0) events. Not real users, real claims, or production workload.

deployment.package: container image (ECR) + AWS Lambda Web Adapter 0.8.4
deployment.built_by: CodeBuild project pbm-claims-build from GitHub commit 3f609e0 plus overlay files verified by SHA-256 (pbm/service.py bf22f49605e506e5..., aws/Dockerfile.lambda dbc4c2e54d365ae6...)

complete_run.note: Fresh execution environment (forced by a configuration update). Split across 3 scripted calls because the tool runner caps each script at 100 AWS calls; the service's own counter shows one continuous environment (0 -> 150).

invoke_round_trip_ms.note: Client-side Invoke round trip through the AWS API tool; includes API overhead. Server processing p95 is in monitoring.latency_p95_ms.

normal.deployment: HTTP scoring service; synthetic test traffic
normal.performance_monitoring: Unavailable: no real matured outcome labels
normal.alert_delivery: Persisted SQLite transitions and HTTP endpoint; no external paging

invalid_payload_stage.deployment: HTTP scoring service; synthetic test traffic
invalid_payload_stage.performance_monitoring: Unavailable: no real matured outcome labels
invalid_payload_stage.alert_delivery: Persisted SQLite transitions and HTTP endpoint; no external paging

shifted.deployment: HTTP scoring service; synthetic test traffic
shifted.performance_monitoring: Unavailable: no real matured outcome labels
shifted.alert_delivery: Persisted SQLite transitions and HTTP endpoint; no external paging

recovered.deployment: HTTP scoring service; synthetic test traffic

complete_run.matches_local_integration_test: PSI values 0.0075 (normal), 7.7007 (shifted) and alert-transition values 0.0909/0.2162/0.1179/0.05 equal the local loopback run

cloudwatch_alarm_check.method: After alarms returned to OK, injected 10 invalid payloads (03:27:55Z) and 20 shifted batches (03:27:59Z), then 95 normal requests to clear the service alerts.
cloudwatch_alarm_check.earlier_note: An earlier attempt (03:15Z) that hit the tool's call cap also raised both alerts; alarm transitions at 03:16Z came from that attempt and are not counted here.

other_alarm_observed: pbm-scoring-lambda-duration-p95 went INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> ALARM at 03:11:46Z from cold-start invocations (first invoke ~15.6 s) and back to OK at 03:16:46Z.
bug_found_in_deployment: Lambda Function URL events forward a '?' even with an empty query string; the service matched paths exactly and returned 404. Fixed with urlsplit-based routing and a regression test before validation.

canary.schedule: EventBridge Scheduler pbm-claims-canary, rate(1 minute), one 100-episode /predict request, 2026-10-24T03:27:01Z to 09:27:01Z

limits: Telemetry is per execution environment in /tmp and resets when Lambda recycles it
Reserved concurrency not set: account concurrency limit is 10, which leaves no room to reserve; sequential traffic reused one environment
No outcome labels, so no live AUC or calibration monitoring
SNS topic has no subscriber until one is added
